headline: Sales flat and operating profit edges up, net profit drops
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 5.465T (+1.0% y/y) and operating profit KRW 598.8B (+2.2% y/y); EPS was KRW 1,837, down 42.6% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 1,837 fell 19.7% q/q and 42.6% y/y. Reports of the company's release put revenue at KRW 5.465T and operating profit at KRW 598.8B, with operating profit up 7.1% q/q. Tire operating profit fell 2.6% to KRW 505.9B on raw material and logistics costs; Hanon Systems rose 26.6%. Net profit was KRW 157.8B, down 59.5%.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search extracts attributed to the company's release page on hankooktire.com and StockHub; the release itself was not fetched. EPS is Yahoo data.
